mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 4.5% reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, increasing present value of future earnings and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS remains below 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 315.5 indicates accelerating inflation, triggering central bank rate hikes that compress equity earnings multiples and produce negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 315.5.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous 1-month increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above 0.5% signal robust consumer demand, boosting corporate revenue growth and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both rise > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST and RSAFS both rise > 0.5% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: In low unemployment cycles (UNRATE < 4.0%), a 3-month UNRATE increase exceeding 0.2pp signals economic fragility, reducing corporate profit expectations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 3 months within low unemployment cycles.

mechanism_narrative: Higher housing construction activity (HOUST > 1350) indicates immediate economic momentum, driving short-term equity gains and producing positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST exceeds 1350.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) falling below 100 signals manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate output capacity and generating negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO falls below 100.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous 1-month PAYEMS growth exceeding 0.5% and UNRATE decline exceeding 0.1pp indicate labor market strength, increasing consumer spending power and producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rises > 0.5% and UNRATE falls > 0.1pp in 1 month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS rises > 0.5% and UNRATE falls > 0.1pp in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales (RSAFS) exceeding 720,000 million dollars indicates strong consumer spending, supporting corporate revenue growth and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS exceeds 720000.
